We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. In a typical day as a Site Reliability Engineer Staff, you would... Your work will directly impact scalability, security, and operational efficiency across our platforms. Key responsibilities include:    Enhance Infrastructure as Code (IAC) and enforce best practices.    Optimize cloud infrastructure for scalability, security, and cost-effectiveness.    Develop internal tools to support and streamline cloud platform operations.    Improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows using FluxCD and Jenkins.    Address container image vulnerabilities and standardize remediation processes.    Build Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) aligned with CIS and STIG benchmarks.    Strengthen monitoring, alerting, and observability using Prometheus, Grafana, and logging tools.    Troubleshoot complex production issues to ensure system reliability and customer satisfaction.    Fine-tune distributed systems such as Apache Kafka and Cassandra.    Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to align infrastructure with application needs.       What you need to bring:     Minimum of 6 years of hands-on experience in Infra Ops, Dev Ops, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).    Proficiency with Linux systems, especially Debian-based distributions.    Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and GCP.    Expertise in Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform, Packer, and Ansible.    Solid programming skills in Python and/or Golang.    Deep understanding of containerization (Docker, Container) and orchestration tools (AWS EKS, GCP GKE).    Experience with GitOps workflows.    Proven track record in implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.    Strong background in security and familiarity with security programs.    Experience with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).    Knowledge of both relational (SQL) and non-relational databases.    Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills with a strong sense of ownership.    Experience managing distributed systems like Apache Kafka and Cassandra.    Effective communicator and collaborative team player.    It is mandatory to attend to San Juan office twice a week.       Preferred Qualifications     Experience contributing to open-source projects.    Background in security engineering or related disciplines. title: Senior Application Security Engineer (Java), VP
description_html: About Citi:   Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.     As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.     Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.         The Role:   Citi's Technology Infrastructure team is seeking a  Senior Application Security Engineer (Java)  to own the end-to-end engineering lifecycle, maintenance, evaluation, and rollout of critical authentication and information security platforms. This role bridges Java development, infrastructure automation via Shell scripting and SQL, and deep domain expertise in multifactor authentication mechanisms such as MFA/2FA, OTP, Challenge/Response, and RADIUS. The engineer will certify new SafeWord product releases, stage security patches, and test MFA/RADIUS integrations as part of day-to-day work. They will collaborate closely with operational and engineering teams to certify new releases, troubleshoot complex production issues, and maintain high availability, resilience, and security across enterprise authentication services. The role also supports the team's ongoing initiatives to upgrade legacy authentication components, integrate modern multi-factor mechanisms, and migrate authentication services from VMs toward containerized, cloud-based OpenShift platforms.       Responsibilities     Maintain, enhance, and debug Java-based applications and microservices supporting authentication flows and security controls.  Evaluate new software versions, third-party libraries, and security updates for compatibility, performance, and risk impact.  Implement and configure authentication frameworks and protocols including 2FA/MFA, OTP, Challenge/Response, and RADIUS.  Certify new versions of the SafeWord authentication product prior to production rollout.  Stage and validate security patches across authentication infrastructure.  Test MFA and RADIUS integrations to confirm functionality and compatibility across enterprise applications.  Build and maintain automation scripts in Shell (Bash) to streamline operational tasks and deployments.  Write and optimize database scripts and procedures using SQL and PL-SQL.  Partner with operational teams to test, validate, and certify new software releases before deployment.  Support the migration of authentication services from virtual machines toward containerized platforms on cloud ECS OpenShift.  Support the integration of modern multi-factor authentication mechanisms across enterprise applications as part of the team's legacy upgrade initiatives.  Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for authentication platform operations.        Qualifications     4+ years' progressive experience in software engineering, application security, and/or infrastructure engineering with a strong focus on authentication systems within that experience.  Strong hands-on experience in Java programming, debugging, and maintaining enterprise Java applications.  Solid understanding of authentication mechanisms including Two-Factor/Multi-Factor Authentication (2FA/MFA), One-Time Passwords (OTP), and Challenge/Response architectures.  Practical knowledge of network authentication protocols including RADIUS, LDAP/Active Directory, Kerberos, SAML, and PAM.  Advanced proficiency in Linux/Unix operating systems, including system administration, process management, file permissions, and performance tuning.  Strong Shell scripting skills in Bash and KornShell for task automation and system orchestration.  Proficiency in writing SQL and PL-SQL queries and scripts.  Strong fundamentals in TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS certificates, load balancing, and firewall rule configurations.  Hands-on experience with Splunk, including search syntax, alerts, and dashboards.  Hands-on experience with AppDynamics, including APM and transaction tracing.  Working knowledge of cloud concepts, including AWS, GCP, or enterprise private clouds.  Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with operations, security operations, and engineering teams.  Clear written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and incident retrospectives.  Strong attention to security best practices, access governance, and audit readiness.  Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, OpenShift, or Kubernetes is  preferred .  Experience within Financial Services, Banking, or other highly regulated enterprise environments is  preferred .        Education     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.  Industry certifications in Information Security or Networking are preferred, such as CompTIA Security+, Network+, CEH, or CCNA.      This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.      #LI-MN1                ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family Group:   Technology              ------------------------------------------------------                Job Family:  Systems & Engineering            ------------------------------------------------------              Time Type:  Full time            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location:  Irving Texas United States            ------------------------------------------------------              Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:  $125,760.00 - $188,640.00  In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. title: Senior HPC Site Reliability Engineer
description_html: We are now looking for a Senior HPC Site Reliability Engineer to join our mission and continue improving our HPC infrastructure. A meaningful part of NVIDIA’s strength is our unique and advanced development tools and environments that enable our incredible pace of innovation. We are looking for architects to help us evolve the way our private compute cloud is architected and optimized.        What you will be doing:     Provide leadership in the design and implementation of our large-scale compute cloud that enables the world's top chip modelers, designers, and deep learning experts to invent groundbreaking technology.  Identify architectural changes or completely innovative approaches in our cloud architecture and design.   Help with strategic challenges we encounter, including: effective resource utilization in a heterogeneous compute environment, evolving our private/public cloud strategy, capacity modeling, and planning for multi-year growth and scaling across our global computing environment!         What we need to see:     B.sc in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related field or equivalent experience  8+ years of experience designing and operating large scale compute infrastructure.  Experience with job schedulers such as IBM/Platform LSF, SGE, SLURM, Marathon, Chronos.  Solid understanding of cluster configuration managements tools – Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Salt.  Good experience providing compute services using a public cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)  Strong script-writing skills: Python, Bash, Perl  Knowledge of and/or experience deploying PaaS microservices – Docker, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes  Understanding of fast distributed and network attached storage solutions and Linux file systems, ability to recommend and implement solutions to improve OS performance and reliability.     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Linux certification from a well-known vendor - RedHat, Oracle, etc.  Prior experience managing large-scale Kubernetes deployment in production.  Strong skills in modern container networking and storage architecture.

title: Security Engineer
description_html: Security Engineer    Description -    We are seeking a  Security Engineer  (or  Infrastructure Security Engineer ) to fortify and scale our centralized compute, systems, and networking environments. Your works schedule is hybrid/flex. You will be required to be on site for several days per pay period. This is a hands-on role, and you need to have a background in on premises datacenter deployments. In this role, you will bridge the gap between software engineering, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity—ensuring that our systems are built securely by design without slowing down innovation. This is an operational role and you need at least 3 years’ experience in an operational position.      As a core member of a lean, agile team, you will take ownership of the full lifecycle of our infrastructure. From architecting secure cloud environments and writing Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) to implementing continuous delivery pipelines and driving incident response, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our security posture and business growth.         Key Responsibilities          Secure Architecture & Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC):  Design, provision, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure cloud/compute deployments using modern IaC tools (e.g., Ansible).          Network & Systems Security:  Firewall deployments and management, switch config and compliance.          DevSecOps & CI/CD Integration:  Embed security best practices directly into our continuous delivery pipelines, automating vulnerability scanning, compliance checks, and threat modeling.          Reliability & Resiliency:  Maintain fault-tolerant, high-availability infrastructure that balances stringent security requirements with operational performance.          Incident Response & Threat Mitigation:  Incident triage, root cause analysis, and post-mortems while continuously refining our monitoring, logging, and detection engineering capabilities.          Ideal Qualifications          Core Experience:  Proven track record (typically 5+ years) in security engineering in datacenter on premise  deployments.           Cloud & Virtualization Expertise:  Understanding of modern cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure), virtualization, and centralized compute architectures.          Networking Foundations:  Strong grasp of secure networking protocols, VPC design, firewalls, zero-trust architecture, and VPN/tunneling technologies.          Hardware Experience:  You need experience with computers. This is not a cloud shop and you would need to be very familiar with servers, VM’s and workstation topology and management functions.           Agile Mindset:  Comfortable wearing multiple hats in a fast-paced, small-team environment where autonomy, accountability, and end-to-end ownership are valued.          Education:  Bachelors degree and industry certifications are required.          Salary:   The pay range for this role is  $93,400  to  $143,800  USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.   Benefits:   HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:   Health insurance  Dental insurance  Vision insurance  Long term/short term disability insurance  Employee assistance program  Flexible spending account  Life insurance  Generous time off policies, including;  4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure  11 paid holidays  Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave ( US benefits overview )    The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. description_html: Your work days are brighter here.     We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.           About the Team  Your work matters here. At Workday Government, we focus on outcomes that serve a larger mission. Our work supports U.S. federal agencies as they modernize and transform the full employee lifecycle experience and finance operations—so they can operate with greater clarity, accountability, and trust. As a Fortune 500 company and a proven enterprise cloud platform, Workday brings modern technology, responsible AI, and secure infrastructure to some of the most complex environments in the world. The work isn’t theoretical. It’s operational. It’s high-impact. And it demands rigor, integrity, and long-term thinking.  From day one, you’ll be part of a team that values collaboration, follow-through, and doing the right thing—especially when the stakes are high. Our culture is grounded in integrity, respect, and shared responsibility. We challenge each other to think clearly, act thoughtfully, and build solutions that stand up to real-world demands. Here, curiosity is matched with accountability. Ambition is paired with trust. You’ll have the space to do your best work, the support to keep growing, and the backing of a company committed to long-term investment in both its people and the federal mission.  If you’re looking to apply your experience to meaningful, mission-driven work—alongside colleagues who take pride in building things that last—you’ll find that opportunity at Workday Government.    About the Role       This role will support one or more direct or indirect contracts with the U.S. Federal Government which, due to federal government security requirements, mandates that all Workday personnel working on the contracts be United States citizens (naturalized or native).       This role will handle the operations of many of our team’s services, sitting in the intersection between our development teams and our partners in infrastructure. Your partnership with these teams will drive improvements to our architecture and operating practices with the goal of enabling the smooth operation of our services for our customers. It will also handle on-call support for these services in conjunction with our service and infrastructure teams.  This role will be most successful when addressing a given service’s challenges with a sense of ownership, while also driving the same sense of ownership with other teams which contribute to it.     This role will support one or more direct or indirect contracts with the U.S. Federal Government which, due to federal government security requirements, mandates that all Workday personnel working on the contracts be United States citizens (naturalized or native). An active TS/SCI w/CI Poly is preferred.      We need creative and dedicated Software Engineers, like you, who really want to move the needle. You should enjoy working on projects that can significantly improve developer satisfaction and save the company millions of dollars. By nature, you are inquisitive and ready to question the status quo. You have a passion for exploring and implementing innovative techniques and approaches to solve complex and challenging problems. Most importantly of all you are a superlative collaborator and teammate and bring out the very best in everyone. You feel happiest when working with a highly capable and motivated team of people passionate about software and technology.     Do you love troubleshooting complex systems? Working in partnership with others to brainstorm, identify, and complete improvements in our software and supporting systems?     Basic Qualifications     US Citizenship is required.    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.    4 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.       Other Qualifications     Experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems.    Hands-on operational experience with large-scale distributed systems.    Experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting public cloud infrastructure and applications.      Experience instrumenting applications for observability, including metrics collection, logging, and tracing.    Experience with capacity planning and performance optimization of distributed systems.    Knowledge of incident management processes and post-incident analysis. title: Lead Technical Program Manager, Fraud Technology
description_html: The  Lead Technical Program Manager, Fraud Technology  is responsible for driving end-to-end technology governance, architectural alignment, and delivery execution for Citi’s Enterprise Fraud Prevention initiatives. In this role, you will serve as a technical authority navigating critical cross-functional dependencies across distributed engineering squads, data science teams, core platform services, and risk/compliance partners. You will blend deep systems acumen with executive presence and crisp, diplomatic communication to guide multi-million-dollar programs from architectural discovery through production rollout. This position requires an in-depth understanding of how sub-functional units integrate end-to-end, as well as the ability to coordinate across diverse groups to achieve broad organizational objectives.    Key Responsibilities    End-to-End Program Delivery & Strategic Roadmap Execution    Lead end-to-end technology planning, execution, and delivery governance across complex, mission-critical programs within Citi’s Fraud Technology Book of Work.  Define, baseline, and track program milestones, critical paths, and deliverable commitments across multiple agile squads and hybrid legacy/modernized distributed platforms.  Proactively manage complex cross-program dependencies, identifying technical bottlenecks, architectural conflicts, and resource constraints early to formulate and execute effective mitigation plans.  Establish rigorous Definition of Done (DoD), release readiness criteria, and robust operational cutover strategies tailored for high-throughput, ultra-low-latency financial transaction systems.    Architecture Alignment, Dependency Management & Systems Integration    Guide stakeholders and engineering squads through complex trade-off evaluations, balancing business priorities, customer experience, platform strategy, performance benchmarks, and long-term maintainability.  Facilitate technical architecture reviews, interface design agreements (REST/SOAP APIs, Kafka/event-driven streaming), and binding cross-team integration contracts.  Apply deep technical domain knowledge across core software engineering disciplines, including microservices architectures, distributed API protocols, hybrid cloud and on-premise infrastructure, and resilient data layers.    AI-Augmented Program Management & Operational Excellence    Champion and integrate modern Generative AI (GenAI) and automated tooling to streamline and modernize traditional program management workflows:  Automate the synthesis of complex technical discussions, action items, and Architectural Decision Records (ADRs).  Accelerate the generation of executive dashboards, release notes, and milestone variance analytics.  Standardize AI-driven delivery best practices, prompts, and reporting templates across participating engineering teams.      Executive Presence & Stakeholder Communication    Serve as the primary strategic liaison between engineering teams and executive leadership, articulating delivery health, technical trade-offs, blockers, and architectural risks with clarity, precision, and business context.  Influence, negotiate, and align cross-functional stakeholders across organizational boundaries without formal line authority.  Author and deliver high-impact executive collateral (executive one-pagers, steering committee presentations, risk heatmaps) and crisp briefings to Senior Leadership (MD/C-suite level).  Cultivate strong collaborative partnerships across business units, external technology vendors, operations, internal audit, and technology peers.    Risk, Governance, and Control Management    Proactively identify, evaluate, track, and remediate technical program risks, architectural vulnerabilities, and control deficiencies across all delivery tiers.  Ensure strict compliance with Citi’s Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) governance, architecture review board standards, data governance policies, and relevant regulatory mandates (e.g., OCC, Federal Reserve, PCI-DSS, Model Risk Management).  Champion operational resilience and release integrity, enforcing zero-unauthorized-change policies, comprehensive automated rollback strategies, and stringent incident management protocols.             Qualifications & Competencies     Experience & Domain Expertise     8+ years of experience  in Technical Program Management, Technology Project Management, Engineering Delivery, or related technology leadership roles managing large-scale enterprise initiatives.   2+ years of experience  supporting payments, fintech, fraud prevention, risk management, or other highly regulated technology environments utilizing Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or Hybrid delivery frameworks.  Strong technical fluency in modern software architecture patterns, including microservices, REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architectures (Kafka/MQ), hybrid cloud/on-prem environments, and distributed database systems.  Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, managing dependencies, tracking critical-path milestones, and supporting vendor integrations in matrixed organizations.  Demonstrated ability to deliver complex technology initiatives from planning through production deployment.    Project Management & AI Tooling    PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or comparable project/program management certification preferred.  Hands-on experience with enterprise delivery, portfolio, and collaboration tools including Jira, Confluence, Jira Align, MS Project, and ServiceNow.  Experience utilizing AI-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Copilot, LLMs, or enterprise AI platforms) to support reporting, documentation, meeting synthesis, and delivery management activities.    Leadership & Communication    Demonstrated ability to facilitate stakeholder discussions, drive consensus, and influence technical and business partners in a cross-functional environment.
